timeline.body:
We have implemented https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/99927 in DriverRunner. However, we also need to implement this in ComputeService, where we spawn multiple requests to avoid losing response headers.

Relates #99927

Closes #100163
Closes #102982
Closes #102871
Closes #103028
This class was extracted from DriverRunner.

timeline.body: Hi @dnhatn, I've updated the changelog YAML for you.
Do we need the `STATS` here, given that the `to_ip()` will fail for every document? (just curious)

reply.body: We need to add a `STATS` for executing eval on data nodes. This is needed to reproduce the issue.

timeline.body: Isn't `warnings.size() == expectedWarnings + 1` (the `+ 1` being the header detailing the expression that failed)?

reply.body: We cap the number of warnings per execution pipeline, and we don't limit them again when merging the result on the coordinator; hence, we need to relax the assertion here.
Ah, true (and it was right there in the comment). Thanks!
